title: Digitalis purpurea tea for medicinal use
intro: Digitalis purpurea tea is made from the leaves of the foxglove plant, which has been historically used in herbal medicine. It contains cardiac glycosides, such as digoxin, which can help regulate heart rhythm and improve heart function. This tea is traditionally used to treat conditions like congestive heart failure and arrhythmias. However, it requires careful preparation and dosage due to its potent effects and potential toxicity. It is typically used under the guidance of a qualified herbalist or healthcare professional.
